j3m7xb07.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this 210cm artificial Christmas tree, featuring 1,355 PE and PVC branch tips for a full, realistic appearance inspired by a freshly cut evergreen. Its hinged branches drop into place for quick assembly and fold back for compact storage after the festive season. The flame-retardant foliage and sturdy metal trunk provide durability and reliable support for your favourite Christmas decorations. Ideal for living rooms, lounges, offices and entryways, this pre-lit tree makes it easy to create a festive atmosphere. Specifications: Made from PE and PVC with 1,355 branch tips, integrated LED lights, eight lighting modes, remote control, adjustable brightness, a 6-hour timer, an 18-hour automatic shut-off cycle, hinged branches and a sturdy metal trunk. wn3n6w6e.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Brown - 210 cm
wn3n6w6e.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Brown - 210 cm
wn3n6w6e.sourceDescription: Create the perfect holiday ambiance with this wooden Christmas tree! It adds a unique charm and festive atmosphere to your home, office and other places. Durable material: The stand and the middle pillar are made of solid pine wood. Solid pine wood is a beautiful natural material. Pine wood has a straight grain, and the knots give the material its signature, rustic look. Also, the branches are made of bamboo which is known for its flexibility and hardness.DIY decoration: You have the freedom to unleash your creativity on the wooden Xmas tree, where you can combine it with lightweight LED lights, fairy lights, or other Christmas decorations to craft a one-of-a-kind, attention-grabbing decoration for your home.Space-saving design: After use, you can disassemble the Christmas ornament into multiple parts, and conveniently store all of them in a space-saving manner.Wide application: You can use the wood ornament as part of every holiday decor, not just Christmas but also Easter, Valentine's Day, parties, etc. It is an ideal decoration for homes, weddings, shopping malls, offices and more. Good to know:The delivery includes a wooden tree only; decorations are not included. Product Specifications Solid pine wood (untreated), bamboo Overall dimensions: 110 x 110 x 210 cm (L x W x H) Total height: 210 cm Stand size: 50 x 50 cm (L x W) Number of rods: 29 (2 of them are supplied for replacement) Suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

jg1t9yq4.sourceDescription: This modern artificial Christmas tree exudes a sleek, contemporary style perfect for those who appreciate minimalistic elegance. Defined by its clean lines and functional design, this piece seamlessly blends into both indoor and outdoor settings, offering a sophisticated touch to your festive decor. Its attractive cone shape and warm LED lighting transform any space into a winter wonderland, creating a cozy atmosphere for families and guests. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this modern artificial Christmas tree provides a sense of real evergreen foliage without the maintenance of a live tree. The use of PVC ensures durability and a lifelike appearance that stays vibrant season after season. Its green hue complements any holiday decor with elegance. Included Components: Equipped with LED strip lights and a USB plug, this tree offers convenient, safe lighting. The LEDs emit a warm white glow, filling your space with an inviting ambiance. Easily adjustable, these lights let you craft the perfect atmosphere at your holiday gatherings. Decorative Features: This tree features simple yet striking decorations that enhance its sleek modern look. The decorative accents lend an air of elegance and sophistication, turning your living area or outdoor space into a holiday sanctuary. Recommended Uses: Ideal for various settings, from cozy living rooms to open terraces. Its compact yet prominent presence adapts beautifully to small spaces or as a centerpiece in larger rooms, offering flexibility in decorating styles. Care &Maintenance: For best results, cover the tree when not in use to protect from dust and debris. A certified 5V USB power source is required to operate the tree's LED lights, ensuring optimal performance throughout the holiday season. 4w4wp414.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree serves as a perfect addition to your festive decor, whether placed in the living room or as part of your garden festivities. Its simple, cone-shaped design offers a contemporary twist, combining minimal ornamentation with a functional approach that complements any modern interior. The adaptable nature of this tree makes it an ideal fit for both small apartments and expansive holiday settings, providing a centerpiece that captivates without overwhelming the surrounding space. High-Quality Materials Crafted from durable PVC, this tree boasts longevity and resilience, allowing it to withstand the wear of seasonal setup and storage. The PVC material gives the tree a realistic density, closely mimicking the appearance of natural fir while offering flame-resistant properties for added safety. This ensures that your decor remains both attractive and secure throughout the festive season. Effortless Lighting Equipped with LED strip lights boasting a warm white hue, the tree illuminates your space with a comforting glow. The flexible nature of these lights allows you to position them precisely, enhancing the aesthetic without the frustration of tangled wires. Designed for energy efficiency, these LEDs contribute to an economical holiday display that can brighten any room or garden. User-Friendly Assembly The tree features hinged branches that allow for straightforward assembly, requiring no additional tools besides a screwdriver for the initial setup. This design enables a hassle-free experience, letting you focus more on decoration and less on complicated processes. With clear instructions, the setup is seamless, requiring minimal effort from two people. Versatile Use Designed for both indoor and outdoor settings, this tree adapts to various holiday themes and locations. Its understated elegance allows for creative decoration —whether you're adding traditional ornaments or modern embellishments. The USB power source ensures convenient placement, without the need for proximity to a wall outlet. Care and Longevity When not in use, it is recommended to cover the tree to protect it from dust and elements, ensuring it retains its quality year after year. By following proper care instructions, you can enjoy the tree's beauty season after season without significant wear or deterioration, maintaining its novel appearance and functionality. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and metal Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 97 cm Stand size: 50 x 50 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup, Sturdy metal stand 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on This luxury tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down in the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape, and will save you time as well. Number of PVC tips: 793 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1xArtificialChristmastree,1xStand,1xLEDstringlight,1xPeak,20x3cmball,21x4cmball,20x6cmball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

zex1fpf0.sourceDescription: This handcrafted wicker Christmas tree skirt adds rustic elegance to festive displays and complements a variety of Christmas themes. Made from eco-friendly, renewable wicker in a natural grey colour, it provides a warm and inviting finish while helping to conceal the tree stand. Suitable for living rooms, bedrooms and other decorated spaces, it can be used with both real and artificial Christmas trees and is suitable for trees up to 5 ft in height. Specifications: Handcrafted wicker design with a natural grey finish, made from eco-friendly and renewable wicker, suitable for real and artificial Christmas trees, suitable for trees up to 5 ft, designed to conceal the tree stand, and suitable for use in various indoor spaces. Dimensions: Height: 18 cm, bottom diameter: 45 cm, internal bottom diameter: 40 cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
